{"consolidated_memory":"cli/commands/init.py - Corrupted Scaffold Issues (Two Separate Incidents)

COMPONENT: cli/commands/init.py (developer tooling)
PROBLEM (both incidents): Corrupted scaffold in init command - generated tree missing one file

---

INCIDENT 1: [2026-05-14]
Root Cause: Naive datetime compared against an aware one
Fix: Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
PR: #6218 on branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-5
Repro Steps: Init into a directory that already has a lockfile
Stack: Python
Test: tests/cli/test_init.py
Result: Flaky test went from 58 failures per hundred runs to zero

---

INCIDENT 2: [2026-08-28]
Trigger: Appeared after a rolling restart of the fleet
Root Cause: A listener registered but never removed
Fix: Removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test
PR: #7869 on branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-7
Repro Steps: Init into a directory that already has a lockfile
Stack: Python
Test: tests/cli/test_init.py
Result: Job finished in 19 minutes instead of 3 hours

---

NOTES: Same component, same symptom (missing file in generated tree), same repro steps, but two distinct root causes on two different dates requiring separate fixes."}
